[中文](#cn-v0.5.3) | [English](#en-v0.5.3)

**单一出口：统一返回收口 + 常量集中。** 起因是两个问题 ——「**统一返回有单独封装吗**」「**常量都封装了吗**」。
审计发现 `{ok:...}` 字面量 **44 处、零个构造点**，阈值与受控词表全散落，还实测出**两个真缺陷**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.5.3">新增功能</h3>

本版不新增功能，是一次架构重构 **+ 两个缺陷修复**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.5.3">体验优化</h3>

- **受控词表集中的同时把"教训"编码进类型**（对应 Java 枚举的 code+desc，`desc` 是**写给 AI 看的**）：
  `KINDS`(8) + `KIND_DESC`(8)，例如
  `artboard`「坐标是画布绝对坐标，**不要**参与块间几何比较」、`image`「**没有填充也没有圆角是正常的** —— 尺寸照样要还原」、
  `text`「字重 400 就是 400，别写成 600」、`divider`「还原用 1px 实线，**别用 border-image**」、
  `card`「内边距看「内边距」列，**别再父子相减手算**」。另含 `COLOR_ROLES`(3)、`LIMITS`(12)。
- **`classifyBlock` 重写为只引用常量**：函数体内**再无裸数字、裸类型字面量、裸 role 字面量**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.5.3">问题修复</h3>

- ⭐ **`lanhu_list_teams` 是唯一没有 `ok` 的工具**（返回只有 `teams/teamCount/text`），顺带查出 `list_designs` / `read_design` 也漏。
  **修法不是补字段，而是在工具成功出口统一收口**（`withOk`）—— 将来**任何工具都不可能再漏**，
  并配**源码级断言**（出口必须出现 `withOk(`，覆盖 15 个工具）。
- ⭐ **坏输入"只有失败、没有出路"**：实测 `read_blocks({imageId:'not-a-uuid'})` → 只透传上游 `code=10009：Image not exist`、`hint: null`。
  现在**三个层次都补了"下一步"**：业务异常 / **本地预检**（id 格式不对提前拦，复用既有 `UUID_RE`，没写第二个）/ **schema 拦截**（原来不带给路）。
  **上游错误仍原文一字不改地透传**（已用"格式合法但不存在"的 id 逐字节核实），**只补 `hint`**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.5.3">其他变更</h3>

- 自检 **663 → 676 项**；变异测试 4 组全红；**接口健壮性测试 35 用例：34/35 → 35/35** ✅
- **行为逐字节对比**（改前 vs 改后，12 用例）：差异只有三类且**全部是本次有意为之**
  （字段多 `ok` / schema 失败多一句下一步 / 本地坏 id 提前拦）✅
- **如实记录未做**（均**不影响可观测行为**）：44 处 `{ok:...}` 手拼未全迁（收口已保住契约，剩下是内部风格）；
  P1-1 的"表驱动分类器"未做（阈值已进 `LIMITS`；再抽象会让"为什么这条在前"更难读）。

**Full Changelog**: [v0.5.2...v0.5.3](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.5.2...v0.5.3)

---

<h3 id="en-v0.5.3">New Features</h3>

No new features — this is an architectural refactor **plus two real bug fixes**.

<h3 id="en-v0.5.3">Improvements</h3>

- **Controlled vocabularies centralised, with the lessons encoded into the types** (the Java enum code+desc idea, where
  `desc` is **written for an AI**): `KINDS`(8) + `KIND_DESC`(8) — e.g. `artboard` "coordinates are canvas-absolute,
  **do not** use in inter-block geometry"; `image` "**having neither fill nor radius is normal** — its size still matters";
  `text` "weight 400 is 400, do not write 600"; `divider` "use a 1px solid line, **not border-image**";
  `card` "read the padding column, **stop subtracting parent from child**". Plus `COLOR_ROLES`(3) and `LIMITS`(12).
- **`classifyBlock` rewritten to reference constants only**: no bare numbers, type literals or role literals remain in it.

<h3 id="en-v0.5.3">Bug Fixes</h3>

- ⭐ **`lanhu_list_teams` was the only tool without `ok`** (it returned just `teams/teamCount/text`), and `list_designs` /
  `read_design` turned out to be missing it too. **The fix is not adding the field** — it is a single choke point at the
  tool success exit (`withOk`), so **no tool can ever miss it again**, backed by a **source-level assertion** (the exit must
  contain `withOk(`, covering all 15 tools).
- ⭐ **Bad input produced "failure with no way out"**: `read_blocks({imageId:'not-a-uuid'})` passed through only the upstream
  `code=10009：Image not exist` with `hint: null`. All **three error layers now carry a next step**: business exceptions /
  **local pre-check** (malformed ids caught early, reusing the existing `UUID_RE`) / **schema rejection** (which previously
  offered no guidance). **Upstream errors still pass through verbatim** (verified byte-for-byte with a well-formed but
  non-existent id) — only a `hint` is added.

<h3 id="en-v0.5.3">Chores</h3>

- Self-check **663 → 676 assertions**; all 4 mutation groups turn red; the **35-case tool robustness suite went 34/35 → 35/35** ✅
- **Byte-for-byte behaviour comparison** (before vs after, 12 cases): the only differences are the three intended ones
  (an added `ok`, a schema failure gaining a next step, a malformed id being caught locally) ✅
- **Honestly not done** (neither affects observable behaviour): the 44 `{ok:...}` literals were not all migrated (the choke
  point already guarantees the contract; the rest is internal style); the P1-1 table-driven classifier was not built
  (thresholds already live in `LIMITS`; further abstraction would obscure "why this rule comes first").

**Full Changelog**: [v0.5.2...v0.5.3](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.5.2...v0.5.3)
